title: Lost Mary BM600 Sakura Grape Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: The Sakura Grape Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pods offer a floral twist on a classic grape flavour. Juicy, sweet Grape provides the base, while a subtle Sakura note adds a fragrant lift, creating a smooth yet distinctive vape. Each pack includes two 2ml pods prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, offering up to 600 puffs per pod depending on use. With a smooth mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw, these pods provide consistent flavour without coil changes or refilling. Made exclusively for the Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pod Kit, the pods are quick to install: just click one into the device and enjoy a unique fruit-and-floral blend.
